questions.q: What season was it when the events of this chapter took place?
choices: A bitter cold winter
A hot, dry summer
A wet and rainy spring
A windy early autumn
questions.evidence: It was a bitter cold winter

questions.q: What was unusual about the stranger's left hand?
choices: It was missing two fingers
It was a metal hook
It was badly burned and scarred
It was tattooed with a skull
questions.evidence: wanting two fingers of the left hand

questions.q: What name did the stranger use for the captain?
choices: Bill
Flint
Tom
Jack
questions.evidence: Is this here table for my mate Bill?

questions.q: The stranger peered round the corner "like a cat waiting for a mouse." What does this comparison suggest about him?
choices: He was lying in wait to ambush someone
He was hungry for his breakfast
He was playful and friendly
He was afraid of being caught
questions.evidence: peering round the corner like a cat waiting for a mouse

questions.q: What happened when Jim stepped out into the road?
choices: The stranger angrily ordered him back in
The stranger followed him outside
The stranger gave him a coin
The stranger ran away over the hill
questions.evidence: he ordered me in with an oath that made me jump

questions.q: What clue told Jim that the stranger was frightened himself while they hid behind the door?
choices: He kept swallowing as if he had a lump in his throat
His hands shook so hard he dropped his cutlass on the floor
He began to cry quietly
He kept edging toward the door as if trying to leave the inn
questions.evidence: he kept swallowing as if he felt what we used to call a lump in the throat

questions.q: How did the captain look when he turned and saw the stranger?
choices: Like a man who sees a ghost
Happy to see an old shipmate again
Bored and uninterested
Angry but calm and in control
questions.evidence: he had the look of a man who sees a ghost

choices: Black Dog
Pew
Billy Bones
Long John

questions.q: Why did Black Dog sit sideways next to the door?
choices: To watch the captain and also escape quickly
So he could look out at the sea through the window
Because the chair was broken
So Jim could reach him more easily to serve the rum
questions.evidence: one eye on his old shipmate and one, as I thought, on his retreat

questions.q: What happened after the voices in the parlour grew louder?
choices: The table went over and the men fought with cutlasses
Black Dog paid for his rum and slipped out quietly
The captain grew tired and fell asleep at the table
Jim's mother came down and sent Black Dog away
questions.evidence: the chair and table went over in a lump, a clash of steel followed

questions.q: What stopped the captain's last tremendous cut at Black Dog?
choices: The inn's big signboard
The frame of the inn door
Jim's arm, raised to block it
Black Dog's own cutlass
questions.evidence: intercepted by our big signboard of Admiral Benbow

questions.q: What happened to the captain soon after Black Dog escaped?
choices: He fell to the floor in the parlour
He chased Black Dog over the hill
He packed his sea-chest and left
He sat down and ate his breakfast
questions.evidence: beheld the captain lying full length upon the floor

questions.q: According to Dr. Livesey, what was really wrong with the captain?
choices: He had had a stroke
He had a deep sword wound in his side
He was poisoned
He had broken his leg when he fell
questions.evidence: The man has had a stroke, as I warned him.

questions.q: Which picture was tattooed near the captain's shoulder?
choices: A gallows with a man hanging
A ship in full sail on the sea
A skull and crossed cutlasses
A mermaid holding an anchor
questions.evidence: a sketch of a gallows and a man hanging from it

questions.q: Dr. Livesey calls the gallows tattoo "Prophetic." What does he mean?
choices: It may show how the captain will end up
It is very old and faded
It was drawn by a famous artist in a far port
It is a religious sign to keep sailors safe at sea

questions.q: What warning did the doctor give the captain?
choices: That rum would kill him
That Black Dog would surely come back
That he must leave now
That he would be arrested by the squire
questions.evidence: the name of rum for you is death
